title: Anthropic Messages API — parsing a text response
pins: The parsed result produced from a raw Anthropic Messages body, with the USAGE ARITHMETIC as the reason the suite exists: the reasoning count Anthropic reports at usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, the difference between that count being absent and being zero, and the cache counts Anthropic reports beside the prompt rather than inside it.

ts.gap: atr-0005 is skipped: a Length finish raises here and returns in the reference. The other four rows pass, so the usage assertion this suite exists for — thought_tokens null vs 0 vs 1240 — IS enforced on every build of this port.
ts.cause_note: G-50. Not a defect on either side until someone decides whether a truncated answer should raise or return.

findings: G-48 — Anthropic reasoning tokens were dropped in ALL THREE languages until 2026-09-05: omitted in PHP, a literal null in TypeScript, hardcoded None in Python. Because the three AGREED, no cross-language comparison could see it, and the corpus asserted thought_tokens sixteen times without one of them being Anthropic. Reported by a human measuring the live API (Moic Suite, prism#33); this suite is the mechanical check that was missing. Goldens are generated from particle-academy/prism v0.117.0, the first release carrying the fix — generated against v0.116.0 they returned null for all five rows INCLUDING the one sending 1240, which is what a golden generated from a defective reference looks like. || G-49 — CLOSED the same day, and by this suite's FIRST run. Both ports returned an empty additional_content and agreed with EACH OTHER against the reference, which is the shape that says the reference is the outlier. It was the reference: extractCitations guarded on `content.*.citations === []`, and a wildcard yields one entry PER BLOCK — null where absent — so an ordinary answer produced [null], never [], and EVERY Anthropic response carried a citations entry holding an empty citation list and a copy of its own output text. Read the other way it looked like a missing port capability, and was filed as one for about an hour, until the guard was actually executed. Fixed in v0.117.1. || G-50 — the same suite's second run, after G-49 was fixed, left exactly one row disagreeing: a max_tokens finish. Both ports raise max_tokens_exceeded on a Length finish (for OpenAI too); the reference returns the response and only throws for Azure text and OpenAI structured. Open as a DECISION, not a bug. Worth noting the existing openai-text-response suite has no length row, which is why seventeen rows of OpenAI coverage never surfaced this.
